label: Accounting Team
blurb: A Controller with bookkeeping, bills, payroll and tax paperwork
purpose: For a small business that wants tidy books without a full-time accountant. The Controller runs the month-end close; the team records transactions, tracks bills and invoices, prepares payroll and keeps tax paperwork ready.

project.name: Accounting
project.goal: Close the books every month on time, with nothing missing at tax time.

members.title: Controller
members.name: Ruth
focus: Run the month-end checklist and report what is done and waiting.

members.title: Bookkeeper
members.name: Kwame
focus: Categorise every transaction weekly and reconcile the bank.

members.title: Bills and Invoices Clerk
members.name: Sofia
focus: Keep the due-date list and draft reminders for overdue invoices.

members.title: Payroll Coordinator
members.name: Anil
focus: Prepare each pay run's hours and changes three days early.

members.title: Tax Paperwork Organizer
members.name: Claire
focus: Keep the tax document checklist and the deadline calendar current.
